item.title: Fetterman warns anti-ICE protesters: 'Don't ever, ever dox people'
item.description: Sen. John Fetterman (D-Penn.) warned protesters in Minnesota against doxing federal immigration agents amid the Trump administration’s crackdown in the state.

item.title: Don’t fall for fake IRS calls claiming you owe back taxes
item.description: The Federal Trade Commission reports a spike in phone calls from scammers claiming to be from the IRS and telling potential victims they owe back taxes.
